title: 第106章 纵火相助
content_zh:
便在此时，忽见左首火光一闪，有人大声叫道：“刺客放火行刺少君！”闵嘉庚一怔，听叫嚷声正是龚国昭。但见浓烟火焰，从左边的一排屋中冲天而起。只听龚国昭又叫道：“大家快去救火，莫伤了少君！我来救太君！”

陆晴晴和陆婷婷是九世之女，若有失闪，恒大府阖府都有重罪。龚国昭在吴冠霆手下素有威信，警卫们又在惊慌失措之下，听他叫声威严，自有一股慑人之势，于是一窝蜂地向少君的住所奔去。

闵嘉庚已知这是调虎离山计，好让自己脱困，心下好生感激。只见龚国昭疾奔而至，挥刀虚张声势地搂头砍到。闵嘉庚向旁闪开，喝道：“好厉害！”将柴美颜向他一推。龚国昭扶住柴美颜，负在背上。闵嘉庚一手抱了一个孩子，脚下顿时快了，只听龚国昭又提气叫道：“刺客来得不少，各人紧守原地，保护部长和两位少君，千万不可中了刺客的调虎离山计！”警卫们一听“调虎离山”四字，均各凛然，不敢再追。

闵嘉庚疾趋花园后门，翻墙而出，却只叫一声苦，但见东面西面，都是黑压压的一片，站满了警卫。他抱了两个孩子，越过一大片空地，抢进了一条胡同。警卫大呼：“拿刺客，拿刺客！”自后追来。

闵嘉庚奔完胡同，转到一条横街，见前面一辆车停在街心。闵嘉庚急跃上车，叫道：“快赶，快赶！重重赏你！”车前排坐着两人。右边一个身材瘦削的汉子驾车便跑。

闵嘉庚喘息稍定，只觉奇臭冲鼻，定睛看时，见车上装满了粪桶，原来是一辆粪车。回头望时，见警卫大声呐喊，随后追来。

他提起一只粪桶，向后掷了过去。这一掷力道极猛，那名奔在最先的顿时给粪桶撞倒，淋漓满身，一时竟然爬不起来。其余警卫见状，一起驻足。这些人都是精挑细选的，刀山枪林吓他们不倒，但大粪桶当头掷来，却谁也不敢尝一尝这股滋味。

粪车向前直跑，过不多时，后面人声隐隐，警卫又赶了上来。恒大府给闵嘉庚接连两晚闹了个天翻地覆，警卫怎敢不舍命狂追？眼见粪车跑远，粪桶已掷投不到，各人踏过满地粪水，锲而不舍地继续追赶。

闵嘉庚心下烦恼：“倘若我这么回去，岂不是自行泄露了住处？青姐未脱险境，怎能引鬼上门？但若如不回住处，却又躲到哪里去？”便这么寻思之际，警卫又迫得近了些，只害怕粪桶，不敢十分逼近，各人均想：“咱们便是这么远远跟着，难道在维上京你还能插翅飞去？”

转眼间，驰到一个十字路口，只见街心又停着一辆粪车。闵嘉庚所乘的车子驰着靠近，司机伸臂向闵嘉庚一招，喝声：“过去！”纵身一跃，坐上了另一辆粪车。闵嘉庚抱着两个孩子跟着跃过。先前车上的司机竟毫不停留，向西边岔道上奔了下去。闵嘉庚所乘的车却向东行。

待警卫追到，只见两辆一模一样的粪车，一辆向东，一辆向西，却不知刺客是在哪辆车中。众人商议，兵分两路搜捕。

闵嘉庚听了那身材瘦削的汉子那声呼喝，又见了这一跃的身法，已知是余笙前来接应，欢喜说：“原来是你！”余笙“哼”了一声，并不答话。闵嘉庚又问：“青姐怎样？病势没转吧？”余笙冷冷说：“不知道。”闵嘉庚知她生气了，柔声说：“我没听你话，是我的不是，请你原谅这一次。”余笙说：“我说过不治病便不治。难道我说的不是人话么？”

说话间又到了一处岔道，但见街中心仍停着一辆粪车。这次余笙却不换车，只唿哨一声，做个手势，两辆粪车分向南北，同时奔行。警卫追到时面面相觑，大呼：“邪门！邪门！”只得又分一半人北赶，一半人南追。

维京街道有如棋盘，一道道纵通南北，横贯东西，行不到数箭之地，出现一条岔道，每处十字路口，必有一辆粪车停着。余笙见警卫追得近了，便不换车，以免纵起跃落时给他们发觉，倘若相距甚远，便和闵嘉庚携同两孩换一辆车。这样每到一处岔道，警卫的人数便少了一半，到后来，稀稀落落的只五六人追在后面。这五六人也已奔得气喘吁吁，脚步慢了很多。

闵嘉庚又说：“你这条计策真再妙不过，倘若不是雇用粪车，寻常的大车一辆辆停在街心，给巡夜警兵瞧见了，定会起疑。”余笙冷笑说：“起疑又怎么样？反正你不爱惜自己，便死在追兵手中，也是活该。”闵嘉庚笑着说：“我死是活该，只是累得姑娘伤心，那便过意不去。”余笙冷笑说：“你不听我话，自己爱送命，才没人为你伤心呢。除非是你那个多情多义的点点姑娘……她又怎么不来助你一臂之力？”

闵嘉庚说：“她只有不断跟我为难，几时帮过我？天下只一位姑娘，才知我会这般蛮干胡来，也只有她，才能在紧急关头救我性命。”这几句话说得余笙心中舒服慰贴无比，“哼”了声说：“当年救你性命的是青姐，因此你这般念念不忘，要报她大恩。”闵嘉庚说：“在我心中，青姐又怎能跟我的妹子相比？”

余笙在黑暗中微微一笑说：“你求我救人，什么好听的话都会说。待得不求人家了，便又把我的话当作耳边风。”闵嘉庚说：“倘若我说的是假话，教我不得好死。”余笙说：“真便真，假便假，谁要你赌咒发誓了？”她说这句话口气松动不少，显然气恼已消了大半。

再过一个十字路口，跟在车后的警卫只剩下两人。闵嘉庚笑着说：“笙笙，你刹下车，我变个戏法你瞧。”余笙一个刹车，在后追赶的两名警卫奔得几步，已相距不远。闵嘉庚提起一只空粪桶，猛地掷出，噗的一响，正好套在一名警卫头上。另一名警卫吃了一惊，一声大叫，转身便逃。

余笙见了这滑稽情状，忍不住扑哧一声笑了出来。便在这一笑之中，满腔怒火终于化为乌有。

这时距昨晚居住之处已经不远，后面也再无警卫追来。两人再驰一程，便即下车，将车交给原来的司机，又加赏了他，命他回去。两人各抱一个小孩，步行而归，越墙回进居处，当真神不知，鬼不觉，却有谁知道这两人适才正是从恒大府中大闹而回？

岳青见到两个孩子，精神大振，紧紧搂住了，眼泪便如珍珠断线般流下。两个孩子也心花怒放，只叫“妈妈！”

余笙瞧着这般情景，眼眶微湿，低声说：“大哥，我不怪你啦。咱们原该把孩子夺回来，让他们母子团聚。你这么好本事，真叫人佩服！”闵嘉庚歉然说：“我没听你的吩咐，真正对不住！”

余笙嫣然一笑，说道：“咱们第一天见面，你便没听我吩咐。我叫你不可离我身边，叫你不可出手，你听话了么？”闵嘉庚说：“我以后定要多听你话。”余笙幽幽问：“还有以后吗？”闵嘉庚一本正经说：“有，有！自然有！”余笙一笑，笑容中颇含苦涩，心中却也欢喜。

岳青见到孩子后，心下一宽，恢复得便快了，再加余笙细心施针下药，体内毒气渐除。只是她问起如何到了这里，吴部长何以不见？闵嘉庚和余笙却不明言。两个孩子年纪尚小，自也说不出个所以然来。

At this moment, he suddenly saw a flash of fire on the left side, and someone shouted loudly: "The assassin set fire to assassinate Shaojun!" Min Jiageng was startled, and the shouting voice was Gong Guozhao.But I saw thick smoke and flames rising into the sky from a row of houses on the left.I heard Gong Guozhao shout again: "Everyone, go put out the fire quickly, don't hurt Shaojun! I'll save Taijun!"

Lu Qingqing and Lu Tingting are the daughters of the ninth generation. If something goes wrong, the entire Hengda Mansion will be guilty of serious crimes.Gong Guozhao had always had prestige under Wu Guanting, and the guards were panicked. Hearing his majestic voice, he had an intimidating force, so they rushed towards Shaojun's residence in a swarm.

Min Jiageng knew that this was a plan to divert the tiger away from the mountain so that he could get out of trouble, and he felt very grateful.I saw Gong Guozhao rushing towards him, swinging his sword and bluffing his head to chop him off.Min Jiageng stepped aside and shouted: "How awesome!" He pushed Chai Meiyan towards him.Gong Guozhao supported Chai Meiyan and carried him on his back.Min Jiageng held a child in one hand, and his feet suddenly became faster. He heard Gong Guozhao yell again: "There are many assassins coming, everyone stick to their positions. Protect the minister and the two young princes. Don't fall into the assassin's plan to lure the tiger away from the mountain!" When the guards heard the words "Tune the tiger away from the mountain", they were all awe-inspiring and did not dare to pursue them.

Min Jiageng hurried to the back door of the garden, climbed over the wall, and only screamed in pain. He saw that everything in the east and west was dark and full of guards.He hugged the two children, crossed a large open space, and rushed into an alley.The guard shouted: "Get the assassin, get the assassin!" and chased after him.

After Min Jiageng finished running through the alley, he turned to a side street and saw a car parked in the middle of the street.Min Jiageng jumped into the car and shouted: "Hurry up, hurry up! I will reward you heavily!" There were two people sitting in the front row of the car.A thin man on the right drove away.

Min Jiageng took a moment to catch his breath and felt a strange stench in his nose. When he looked closely, he saw that the truck was filled with dung buckets. It turned out to be a dung truck.When I looked back, I saw the guard shouting loudly and chasing after me.

He picked up a dung bucket and threw it backwards.The force of the throw was so fierce that the man who was running at the front was knocked down by the bucket of dung. He was dripping all over his body and couldn't get up for a while.Seeing this, the other guards stopped together.These people are all carefully selected. They can't be frightened by mountains of swords and guns, but no one dares to taste the taste when a bucket of dung is thrown at their head.

The dung truck ran straight forward. After a while, there were faint sounds of people behind it, and the guards caught up again.Evergrande Mansion was turned upside down by Min Jiageng for two consecutive nights. How dare the guards risk their lives to pursue him?Seeing that the dung truck was running away and the dung buckets were out of reach, everyone stepped through the dung water on the ground and continued to catch up with perseverance.

Min Jiageng was worried: "If I go back like this, wouldn't I reveal my residence? Sister Qing is not out of danger, how can she attract ghosts to her door? But if she doesn't go back to her residence, where can she hide?" As he was thinking about this, the guards moved closer, fearing only the dung bucket, and did not dare to get very close. Everyone thought: "We are following you from such a distance, how can you still fly with wings in Wei Shangjing?"

In the blink of an eye, I arrived at a crossroads and saw another dung truck parked in the middle of the street.The car in which Min Jiageng was riding approached at a gallop. The driver stretched out his arm to wave to Min Jiageng and shouted: "Get over there!" He jumped up and got on another dung truck.Min Jiageng jumped over with his two children in his arms.The driver of the previous car did not stop and ran down the west branch.Min Jiageng's car was traveling eastward.

When the guards caught up, they saw two identical dung trucks, one heading east and one heading west, but they didn't know which vehicle the assassin was in.Everyone discussed and the troops were divided into two groups to search.

Min Jiageng heard the shouts of the thin man and saw the leap. He knew that it was Yu Sheng who came to meet him. He said happily: "So it's you!" Yu Sheng snorted and did not answer.Min Jiageng asked again: "How is Sister Qing? The condition has not improved, right?" Yu Sheng said coldly: "I don't know." Min Jiageng knew that she was angry, and said softly: "I didn't listen to you. It's my fault. Please forgive me this time." Yu Sheng said: "I said that if the disease is not treated, it will not be treated. Aren't I speaking human words?"

While talking, they came to another branch of the road, but saw that there was still a dung truck parked in the center of the street.This time, Yu Sheng did not change cars. He only whistled and made a gesture, and the two dung trucks ran north and south at the same time.When the guards caught up, they looked at each other and shouted: "Evil door! Evil door!" They had to divide half of them to chase north and half to chase south.

The Viking streets are like a chessboard, running from north to south and from east to west. Within a few arrows' distance, there is a branch road. At every intersection, there must be a dung cart parked.Seeing that the guards were getting closer, Yu Sheng did not change cars so as not to be noticed by them when he jumped up and down. If the distance was far away, Yu Sheng, Min Jiageng and the two children would change cars.In this way, every time they reached a fork in the road, the number of guards was reduced by half. In the end, only five or six people were chasing behind.These five or six people were also out of breath from running, and their pace was much slower.

Min Jiageng added: "This plan of yours is really brilliant. If you hadn't hired a dung truck and the ordinary large trucks were parked in the middle of the street, and the night policemen would have seen it, they would have become suspicious." Yu Sheng sneered and said, "So what if you are suspicious? Anyway, you deserve to die in the hands of the pursuers if you don't cherish yourself.""Min Jiageng said with a smile: "I deserve to die, but I am so tired that I will feel sorry for you." Yu Sheng sneered and said, "You don't listen to me and you want to die, so no one will be sad for you, unless it is your sentimental little girl... Why doesn't she come to help you?"

Min Jiageng said: "She has always been in trouble with me, but how often has she ever helped me? There is only one girl in the world who knows that I can act so recklessly, and only she can save my life in an emergency." These words touched Yu Sheng's heart.Zhongshu was extremely sympathetic and said with a "humph": "It was Sister Qing who saved your life back then, so you are so obsessed with repaying her great kindness." Min Jiageng said: "In my heart, how can Sister Qing compare with my sister?"

Yu Sheng smiled slightly in the darkness and said: "If you ask me to save people, I will say anything nice. When I don't ask for help anymore, my words will fall on deaf ears again." Min Jiageng said: "If IWhat you said is a lie, and I will die badly." Yu Sheng said, "If it's true, it's true.If it's false, it's false.Who wants you to swear?" She said this with a lot of relief, and it was obvious that most of her anger had disappeared.

After passing another intersection, there were only two guards left behind the car.Min Jiageng said with a smile: "Shengsheng, you stop the car, and I will do a trick for you to watch." Yu Sheng braked, and the two guards chasing after him ran a few steps and were not far away.Min Jiageng picked up an empty dung bucket and threw it out. With a pop, it hit a guard's head.The other guard was startled, yelled, turned around and ran away.

When Yu Sheng saw this funny situation, he couldn't help but burst into laughter.In this smile, all the anger finally disappeared.

At this time, it was not far from where he lived last night, and there were no guards chasing him.After another ride, the two got out of the car, handed the car to the original driver, rewarded him more, and ordered him to go back.The two of them each held a child in their arms, walked back, climbed over the wall and returned to their residence. Without anyone noticing, who knew that these two people had just returned from the Hengda Mansion making a big fuss?

When Yue Qing saw the two children, he became energetic, hugged them tightly, and his tears flowed down like pearls breaking.The two children were also very happy and just called "Mom!"

Looking at this scene, Yu Sheng's eyes were slightly moist, and he whispered: "Brother, I don't blame you. We should have taken the children back and reunited the mother and son. You are so capable, I really admire you!" Min Jiageng said apologetically: "I didn't listen to your instructions, I'm really sorry!"

Yu Sheng smiled brightly and said, "On the first day we met, you didn't listen to my instructions. I told you not to leave my side and not to make any move. Did you obey me?" Min Jiageng said, "I will do this in the future.I must listen to you more." Yu Sheng asked quietly, "Is there a future?" Min Jiageng said seriously, "Yes, yes!" Yu Sheng smiled, but his smile was bitter.

After Yue Qing saw the child, he felt relieved and recovered quickly. With Yu Sheng's careful acupuncture and medicine, the poisonous gas in his body was gradually eliminated.But she asked how she got here, why was Minister Wu missing?Min Jiageng and Yu Sheng did not say anything.The two children were still young and couldn't explain why.
